CLO Virtual Fashion Inc. is a South Korean software company founded in 2009 by Jaden Oh, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. The company develops CLO, a 3D apparel design tool for the fashion industry, as well as Marvelous Designer, a similar tool designed for use in the film and video game industries.
Collaborations & Partnerships
Balmain
CLO has been used to create clothing on computer-generated models and virtual influencers for fashion editorials and e-commerce, as well as in augmented and virtual reality digital fashion experiences. In September 2018, Balmain, under creative director Olivier Rousteng's creative direction, partnered with CLO Virtual Fashion to recreate digital renderings of real-life garments.
Epic Games
In May 2023, CLO Virtual Fashion and Epic Games, the developer of Unreal Engine, announced they each purchased shares of each other.
Awards
In January 2024, the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences honored Jaden Oh with a Scientific and Engineering Award for the concept and development of Marvelous Designer.
